s01061.summary: Six fleece-vested employees stand around a locked chest in a corporate escape room.
Gregor preaches teamwork while Priya and Marcus watch the clock.
They read the clue about the greatest quarter; Todd calls it every quarter.
Delilah points to the whiteboard showing 1742, deflating Gregor.
Priya enters the code, the chest opens, revealing a survey card.
They stand in deflated silence as the clock keeps beeping.

s01078.summary: June counts quarters alone at a 1989 skating rink concession.
Danny enters carrying a gym bag and waits for the big room to open.
They chat shyly; June shares free popcorn.
Danny shows a missing-person flyer for his sister Rosalind, who worked there.
June admits she took Rosalind's shifts when she left.
June says Pruitt keeps a locked room with Rosalind's jacket on the door.
Pruitt announces the big room opens early, forcing June to put off showing him.
June gives Danny a ring of keys and tells him to come at four.
Danny pockets the keys and walks into the crowd as June returns to the register.

s01077.summary: Orozco spots dust on the east road while Voss studies a map by the locomotive.
Voss tells the gripping Orozco to breathe, then checks the road herself.
Voss rejects hiding in the engine and pulls out a mirror to signal.
Orozco asks what if no one is there; Voss will signal anyway.
She stops his rifle with a gentle hand; he starts counting as engines rise.

s01062.summary: Two strangers sit silently on a stranded bus; Emery calls out, Naomi answers curtly.
Emery hears tapping; Naomi insists it's the cold.
Emery says she'll check the luggage rack; they awkwardly stand together in the aisle.
A wet noise sounds and a duffel unzips itself.
They back toward the rear emergency door and Emery fumbles for the lever.
Pale fingers slide out of the bag and curl around the rack.
Emery yanks the door open and they tumble out into the gravel.
They crawl from the road and hear a hand tap on the bus glass.

s01112.summary: Three glacier travelers haul a sled across ice; Desmond lags with a swollen ankle.
Nadia calls a ten-minute rest despite Nat's objection.
They share a thermos and Nadia points out the pass six kilometers away.
Desmond insists he can walk or crawl; Nadia says nobody crawls.
Nat ties Desmond to the sled as an anchor to keep him going.
They haul toward the pass in silence as shadows lengthen.

s00009.summary: The Hellcats are down nine in the final jam while Bruise laces her skates.
Tamara coaches Bruise to stay left and slaps the bench once.
At the line Dot and Bruise trade barbs about her limp and age.
Their eyes finally meet in silence as the referee lifts his whistle.

s01026.summary: Captain Voss folds laundry in the night cycle while Amara urges her to rest.
Koji reports a persistent coolant drift that he has fixed three times.
The ship AI reports pressure variance in the nursery compartment.
Pell bursts in saying someone is banging inside the empty cold lock.
Knocking begins and Amara recognizes the medical emergency code.
Voss orders the lock opened; Terrapin refuses citing a seal order from four hundred days ago.
As the knocking quickens and frost spreads, Voss grabs a wrench and runs.

s01106.summary: Hazel and Jonah meet at a ferry cafe with a stranger beside them.
Hazel presses Jonah for missing the ferry again.
Wendell chimes in from behind his paper, and Hazel sides with him.
Jonah and Hazel laugh despite themselves as the horn blasts.
Jonah quietly apologizes and Hazel says she knows.

s01051.summary: Juniper presses the last cider of the season as her family and a buyer look on.
Colm hears breathing under the sound of cider; a slow wet inhale follows.
Rhys blames pipes while Juniper says there is no basement and the ground dislikes digging.
Juniper and Beata exchange a look and keep a secret from the buyer.
Juniper tastes the cider calmly and orders Colm to put his harmonica down.
The breathing quickens and a barrel bulges as if something leans out.
Everyone scatters while Juniper takes a mallet and orders them out quietly.
Alone, Juniper raises the mallet and waits for the barrel.

s01022.summary: Mabel works the switchboard alone at night in 1924.
A rain-soaked stranger enters unannounced and demands the Harrisburg line.
Mabel refuses him, calling the trunk company use only.
He gives his name as Crowe of the state railway board and shows a paper.
Mabel wakes the manager, who agrees to put Crowe through after hearing about the freight.
Toby bursts in reporting the east line cut at the Calder bridge.
Mabel asks how Crowe knew about the freight; Toby spots copper wire in his satchel.
The board lights up and the sheriff's line clicks live.
Mabel tells Crowe to stay put and Toby to lock the door.

s01104.summary: A rusted water tower stands over the windy high plains.
Marshal Dunmore rides in to meet Odessa and the boy Lazarus.
He learns the Whitaker brothers have climbed the tower with a Winchester and jug.
Dunmore reports by radio to Fort Bell that reinforcements will be too late.
He hands Odessa her rifle back, tips his hat, and climbs the ladder.

pd_earnest_5.summary: The couples declare devotion and fall into each other's arms.
Merriman announces Lady Bracknell, who finds the couples embracing.
She demands what this means and orders Gwendolen to sit.
She forbids all communication between Jack and her daughter.
She asks after Bunbury and Algernon fumbles into saying he has died.
Learning Algernon is engaged to Cecily, she questions Jack about her origins.
She demands proof of Cecily's pedigree; Jack answers coldly.

s01040.summary: Botanist Ilsa tends tomatoes in a greenhouse on a tidally locked world.
Bram reports the heat sink is at ninety-four percent and rising.
Quillon runs in to report the shade array is jammed by a bolt.
Sephora radios that a heat stroke patient is asking for Ilsa: her daughter.
Ilsa orders the tomatoes into the cold room and the array fixed, then leaves.
Ilsa runs to her daughter; Quillon warns the glass will crack in ten minutes.

s01096.summary: Detective Inez leads officers along the catwalk toward a crouched figure with a briefcase.
The figure warns them not to come closer, calling the case a promise.
Dorothea sends Augusto to find the chandelier cable cut-off.
The figure turns out to be Violetta, an ex-soprano in tennis shoes.
Violetta says she was fired from this house after four hundred nights.
Barnabas aims his gun; Inez orders him to lower it.
A spotlight finds Violetta; the case spills blank sheet music and no bomb.
Violetta sings one clear note as the orchestra falls silent and all listen.

s01030.summary: Inspector Strozzi records notes beside the star projector in the abandoned planetarium.
She lifts the lens cap and finds a fresh thumbprint in grease.
She records that someone has drawn stars in chalk on the dome, then the projector clicks.

s01111.summary: Five friends hide in the dark whispering as they wait to surprise the guest of honor.
The doorknob rattles and keys scrape as they freeze.
The door opens on a pizza delivery man instead of the guest.
The lights flip, everyone shouts surprise and the cake lands on Tibby.
Frosting-covered Tibby takes the wrong-apartment pizza.

s00007.summary: Rosalind wraps trophies as the family bowling alley closes for good.
Rosalind tells restless Devante to stop clicking the lever.
Pearl recalls their father's 290 game while Devante corrects her.
Devante questions keeping the trophies, calling them junk.
Pearl presses about the buyer turning the alley into a gym.
Devante walks the length of lane nine, then steps off.
Pearl says her father always said Rosalind would close up.
Pearl offers their father's old bowling shirt left in her car.
Devante takes the shirt, folds it, and lays it on top of the box.
Pearl confirms the eight o'clock buyer, promises coffee, and goes.
The siblings wrap the last trophy together and Devante kills the radio.

s00018.summary: Pippa asks Grandpa Ezekiel about falling off boats and he answers dryly.
Junior asks to get off at the next stop, but it's a ferry and they're committed.

s01100.summary: Yasmin and Waldemar tend the greenhouse ring while the commander gazes at Earth.
Iris announces Mission Control has extended their stay by six months.
Iris touches a tomato plant and talks of harvest to hide her feelings.
Iris asks for four teas and Halcyon notes only three are present.
Iris walks off down the corridor, trailing her hand along the rack.
Waldemar asks who the fourth was; Yasmin says she will tell him later.

s01083.summary: Archivist Thessaly copies runes while a voice murmurs through the library walls.
The voice claims she took something and asks her to read the last page.
Kestrel reads the warning that opening the book wakes its writer.
A raven-headed stranger forms in the air, introducing himself as the Scribe.
Thessaly says the pages belong to the kingdom; the Scribe says he wrote it all.
His shadow writes Kestrel's name and declares her death in tonight's pages.
Thessaly ignites her quill and draws a barrier of light that makes him flinch.
Kestrel slams the glowing book shut and refuses to give it back.
The Scribe dissolves into ink and vows to wait.
Silence returns, but the warm book cover beats with something inside.

s00013.summary: Silas kneels beside a dead horse in the abandoned evaporation works.
Connie appears twenty feet away with a canteen and a rifle.
She offers water for a name; he quips back, and the water slaps loudly.
He steps closer and her hand drifts to the rifle sling.
Silas calls her denial of Dutch Halloran a bad lie.
He warns that Halloran is coming with six men and a Gatling gun.
They share water and discover each lost a loved one to the same man.
Connie proposes sinking the wagon in the brine; Silas finds a better plan lacking.
Silas checks his revolver and takes cartridges from her as dust rises on the ridge.
She goes to pick a vat; he touches the horse's mane and follows.
